narr: Isolated storms developed across central Virginia on August 28 and became nearly stationary, producing heavy rain and localized Flash Flooding.
ev: There were numerous reports of high water on North Hopkins Road and Richmond Highway. These reports were relayed from the Waze app.
The public reported high water along Commerce Road.
